import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Trim whitespace and standardize species labels
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip()
    # Map known misspellings/variants to the correct species names
    variant_map = {
        'adelie': 'Adelie',
        'Adeile': 'Adelie',
        'Gentoo ': 'Gentoo',
        'Chinstarp': 'Chinstrap',
        'Chinstrap ': 'Chinstrap'
    }
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace(variant_map)
    # Convert body_mass_g from text (possible commas) to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', ''))
    # Fix flipper_length_mm: it is stored as text in some rows, convert to numeric and drop out-of-range/negative values
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'])
    # Remove rows with invalid flipper_length (out of range or negative) – these are data errors
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and sum the body mass
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum().to_dict()
    return result
